next_steps: Run isolated cosine, relational, and hybrid COCO ablations with the same initialization and at least 3 seeds.
Move the effect gate to a resource-adequate GPU budget and report APs/APm/APl, mAP50-95, wall time, and peak memory.
Run single-GPU and GPU real-teacher smoke tests, then benchmark stripped PyTorch/ONNX student latency.
Only after those gates pass, decide whether to tag the alpha release or proceed to the next research phase.
